rows.headline: Sandisk jumps 16% as beaten-down memory stocks rebound after the Thanksgiving break
rows.summary: Sandisk rose 16.0% to $85.36 in Friday's shortened session, leading a rebound in memory and storage stocks after a steep November sell-off. Micron gained about 7.6%, and a Kioxia demonstration of flash storage extending GPU memory for Nvidia systems added to the move.

rows.headline: Bradesco ADRs jump 15% as Brazil's market soars on talk of its chairman becoming finance minister
rows.summary: Bradesco's US-listed shares rose 15.2% to $2.80, catching up with a big rally in São Paulo while US markets were closed for Thanksgiving: the Ibovespa jumped 6.1% on 26 November on speculation that Luiz Trabuco, chairman of Bradesco's board, would become Brazil's finance minister.

rows.headline: Itaú Unibanco ADRs rise 11% with Brazil's two-day rally on finance-minister speculation
rows.summary: Itaú Unibanco's US-listed shares rose 11.3% to $7.66 on Friday, the first US session after Thanksgiving, as they caught up with a 6.1% jump in Brazil's Ibovespa on 26 November driven by speculation that Bradesco chairman Luiz Trabuco would become finance minister.

rows.n: Companhia de Saneamento Basico DO Estado de Sao Paulo-Sabesp
